jobDescription:
Job Description:

A motivated and detail-oriented Computer Science graduate with hands-on experience in developing web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js). Skilled in building responsive user interfaces, integrating REST APIs, and working collaboratively with backend teams to ensure seamless functionality and performance.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain web applications using React.js and Node.js
Design and implement RESTful APIs using Express.js
Work with MongoDB for database design and data management
Build responsive and user-friendly UI using HTML, CSS, Tailwind/Bootstrap
Collaborate with backend teams to integrate APIs efficiently
Debug, test, and optimize applications for performance
Participate in code reviews and follow best coding practices

Skills:

Frontend: React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, CSS
Backend: Node.js, Express.js
Database: MongoDB
Tools: Git, GitHub, Postman, Vite
Basic understanding of authentication (JWT), APIs, and deployment

Experience:

UI Intern (Angular) at Tech Mahindra
– Developed responsive UI components and integrated APIs with backend services

Projects:

Criminal Record Detection System (Image Processing based)
MERN-based Web Applications

Soft Skills:

Problem-solving mindset
Quick learner
Team collaboration
roadmap: Step 1: Learn Git and GitHub by completing online tutorials and contributing to open-source projects. Step 2: Familiarize yourself with Vite by building small projects and exploring its features. Step 3: Learn Bootstrap by taking online courses and building responsive UI components. Step 4: Practice deploying applications using Vite and Bootstrap. Step 5: Review and refine your skills by working on personal projects and participating in coding challenges.
